prayers.title: Sign of the Cross

translations.en: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

prayers.title: Apostles' Creed

translations.en:
I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth,
and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,
who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
born of the Virgin Mary,
suffered under Pontius Pilate,
was crucified, died and was buried;
he descended into hell;
on the third day he rose again from the dead;
he ascended into heaven,
and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty;
from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.

I believe in the Holy Spirit,
the holy catholic Church,
the communion of saints,
the forgiveness of sins,
the resurrection of the body,
and life everlasting. Amen.

prayers.title: Our Father
Hail Mary

translations.en:
Hail Mary, full of grace,
the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

prayers.title: Glory Be

translations.en:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be,
world without end. Amen.

prayers.title: Rosary Prayer (Fatima)

translations.en: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of thy mercy. Amen.

prayers.title: Hail, Holy Queen

translations.en:
Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy,
our life, our sweetness, and our hope.
To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve;
to thee do we send up our sighs,
mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.

Turn then, most gracious Advocate,
thine eyes of mercy toward us;
and after this, our exile,
show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

Pray for us, O holy Mother of God,
that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ. Amen.

prayers.title: Rosary Prayer

translations.en:
Let us pray.

O God, whose only begotten Son, by his life, death, and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life,
grant, we beseech thee, that meditating upon these mysteries of the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary,
we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise,
through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Joyful Mystery 1: The Annunciation

translations.en: We contemplate the angel Gabriel announcing to Mary that she is chosen to bear the Savior. In humble faith she replies, "Let it be done to me according to your word." We ask for the grace to say yes to God promptly and joyfully.

prayers.title: Joyful Mystery 2: The Visitation

translations.en: Mary hastens to Elizabeth, carrying Jesus to her cousin's home. John the Baptist leaps in the womb and Elizabeth proclaims Mary blessed. We ask for charity that moves us to serve and to bring Christ to others.

prayers.title: Joyful Mystery 3: The Nativity

translations.en: Jesus is born in Bethlehem, laid in a manger, and adored by Mary and Joseph. The shepherds come in wonder and praise. We ask for poverty of spirit and a heart that welcomes Christ with gratitude.

prayers.title: Joyful Mystery 4: The Presentation of the Child Jesus in the Temple

translations.en: Mary and Joseph present Jesus to the Lord in the Temple, fulfilling the Law. Simeon recognizes the Messiah and foretells that a sword will pierce Mary's heart. We ask for obedience and devotion to God's will.

prayers.title: Joyful Mystery 5: The Finding of the Child Jesus in the Temple

translations.en: After three days of searching, Mary and Joseph find Jesus among the teachers in the Temple. He is about his Father's business. We ask for the grace to seek Jesus first and to remain close to him in all things.

prayers.title: Luminous Mystery 1: The Baptism of the Lord in the Jordan

translations.en: Jesus is baptized by John in the Jordan and the heavens open. The Father's voice declares him beloved, and the Spirit descends upon him. We ask for fidelity to our baptism and a renewed life in the Holy Spirit.

prayers.title: Luminous Mystery 2: The Wedding Feast at Cana

translations.en: At Mary's intercession Jesus performs his first sign, changing water into wine. The disciples begin to believe more deeply in him. We ask for trust in Mary’s guidance and obedience to Christ’s words: "Do whatever he tells you."

prayers.title: Luminous Mystery 3: The Proclamation of the Kingdom

translations.en: Jesus proclaims the Kingdom of God and calls all to repentance and faith. He forgives sins and heals the sick as signs of God's mercy. We ask for conversion of heart and the courage to live the Gospel.

prayers.title: Luminous Mystery 4: The Transfiguration

translations.en: Jesus is transfigured on the mountain and his glory is revealed to Peter, James, and John. The Father commands, "Listen to him." We ask for deeper prayer and the grace to follow Christ even through suffering.

prayers.title: Luminous Mystery 5: The Institution of the Eucharist

translations.en: At the Last Supper Jesus gives us his Body and Blood under the appearances of bread and wine. He commands, "Do this in remembrance of me." We ask for greater love for the Eucharist and reverence at every Mass.

prayers.title: Sorrowful Mystery 1: The Agony in the Garden

translations.en: Jesus prays in Gethsemane, experiencing sorrow and anguish, yet surrendering to the Father: "Not my will, but yours be done." We ask for strength in temptation and trust in God’s providence.

prayers.title: Sorrowful Mystery 2: The Scourging at the Pillar

translations.en: Jesus is scourged, bearing wounds for our sins. He endures humiliation and pain in silence. We ask for purity of heart and the grace to resist sin.

prayers.title: Sorrowful Mystery 3: The Crowning with Thorns

translations.en: Soldiers mock Jesus as King, pressing thorns into his head and clothing him in purple. He accepts ridicule and injustice for our sake. We ask for humility and patience when we are misunderstood.

prayers.title: Sorrowful Mystery 4: The Carrying of the Cross

translations.en: Jesus carries the cross to Calvary, falling under its weight yet continuing out of love. He meets his Mother and accepts help on the way. We ask for perseverance and the grace to carry our daily crosses faithfully.

prayers.title: Sorrowful Mystery 5: The Crucifixion

translations.en: Jesus is nailed to the cross and offers his life for the salvation of the world. He forgives his enemies and entrusts us to Mary. We ask for the grace of true contrition and to love as Christ loves.

prayers.title: Glorious Mystery 1: The Resurrection of Our Lord

translations.en: On the third day Jesus rises from the dead, conquering sin and death. The tomb is empty and hope is restored. We ask for a living faith and joy that no sorrow can extinguish.

prayers.title: Glorious Mystery 2: The Ascension of Our Lord

translations.en: Jesus ascends into heaven and promises the Holy Spirit. He remains with his Church and prepares a place for us. We ask for a desire for heaven and confidence in Christ’s reign.

prayers.title: Glorious Mystery 3: The Coming of the Holy Ghost upon the Apostles

translations.en: The Holy Spirit descends at Pentecost, filling the apostles with courage and transforming them into witnesses. The Church is born in power and unity. We ask for the gifts of the Holy Spirit and zeal for mission.

prayers.title: Glorious Mystery 4: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin

translations.en: Mary is assumed body and soul into heavenly glory, a sign of God’s promise to his faithful. She is near to us as Mother and intercessor. We ask for purity, hope, and perseverance to the end.

prayers.title: Glorious Mystery 5: The Coronation of the Blessed Virgin

translations.en: Mary is crowned Queen of heaven and earth, radiant with grace. She reigns with her Son and prays for her children. We ask to be faithful disciples and to seek holiness with Mary’s help.
